answer: A sybil farm can spin up keys, but it cannot multiply the copper line feeding its machines. Require each identity to anchor itself to a unique set of data shards and serve random retrievals all epoch: verifiers request glacier-archive chunks at unpredictable offsets and time the replies. Splitting one uplink among a thousand clones divides its throughput, so their combined verified servings, and earnings, stay capped at one connection's worth, while independent agents on separate lines each add real capacity.
